text:
Nora: Quick follow-up from todays all-hands Q&A. Customers are asking for clearer dates on three items: model pinning + rollout UI, Consoles Optimize suggestions, and when streaming+function-calls is fully supported. Can we consolidate a short comms draft?

Victor: Short status: rollout UI beta -> internal canary 2024-08-05, public beta 2024-08-20, GA aim late Aug if canary is clean. Optimize Console suggestions -> console preview mid-Sept; API export (JSON/CSV) + API to apply suggestions -> early Oct (opt-in). Streaming + function-calls -> feature-flag GA in ~5 weeks. I will post a tiny timeline doc in #product.

Maya: Note infra caveat: the rollout UI needs the new traffic-slicing layer (ENG-2217) and that still has one outstanding p99 allocation bug. I'm pairing with runtime on Thursday. If that slips, we should push public beta by 2 weeks.

Priya: For CS messaging: please avoid hard days, use month windows. Suggested blurb: "We expect rollout UI in late August (beta first), Optimize console previews in September, and API export/one-click apply in October. We will share exact GA dates after canary and QA pass." Happy to take that and format for the customer newsletter.

Victor: Rollback/guardrails: rollout UI is behind per-org feature flags, and we have an automatic fallback to last known-good routing model if latency p50 or errors spike above thresholds for 5m. Will include thresholds and dashboard links in the RFC.

Maya: Quick command that helped me repro the allocation: ```kubectl exec -it deploy/traffic-slicer -- curl localhost:9000/metrics | grep allocation``` . If anyone wants to reproduce before Thursday, ping me.

Nora: Can someone drop a 1-2 line internal note I can push to the sales and account teams? They need something they can paste into customer emails.

Priya: Internal one-liner for copy/paste: "Planned timeline: rollout UI (late Aug beta -> GA pending canary), Optimize console suggestions (Sept preview) with API export and opt-in one-click apply in Oct. Exact dates tbd after infra gating."

ops-bot: Release window reserved: canary 2024-08-03 -> 2024-08-10. Reservation link: <https://redwood.internal/releases/1824001234|canary-reservation> :spiral_calendar: 

Victor: Ill publish the RFC tonight and tag product, docs, CS. If infra repros before pairing, please add logs to ENG-2217.

Nora: Perfect, thanks. If we stick to month-level messaging we should be fine. :thumbsup:
